title: Javaslang transpose preserves coordinates and rejects ragged matrices
summary: The public transpose rejects nonrectangular inputs and maps each coordinate of rectangular matrices, including the identity fast paths.

change.description: The public transpose rejects nonrectangular inputs and maps each coordinate of rectangular matrices, including the identity fast paths.

notes: All heights 0 to 3 and row widths 0 to 2 over the alphabet 0 and 1, ordered first by height and then by row word.
The captured original module and its dependencies are identified by SHA-256. The setup record retains build and historical regression evidence.
